# asparagents

> asparagents is the English-speaking studio of Fırat Şekerli, a web and digital marketing specialist based in Ankara, Türkiye, working on websites, social media, SEO and Google Ads since 2013. It builds AI tools for small businesses in specific industries (quotes, bookings, estimates, paperwork and repairs) and connects them to the website the business already has. It also works white label and as an outsourcing partner for agencies and companies: websites, SEO, local SEO, GEO (AI visibility), social media, accessibility fixes and WordPress support. One person handles each project from start to finish, and most messages get a reply within minutes (always within 12 hours, for messages that arrive at night in Türkiye), in English or Turkish.

## AI tools by industry (each page has a working demo with sample data)

- [All industries](https://asparagents.com/industries/): quote tools, booking tools, estimate tools, document chasing and repair triage
- [Window and door companies](https://asparagents.com/industries/windows-doors/): customers configure windows and doors on the website; the tool prices the request and sends a branded proposal with VAT
- [Roofers, plumbers and heating engineers](https://asparagents.com/industries/trades/): answers every enquiry at any hour, spots emergencies and books visits into free slots
- [Builders and renovation companies](https://asparagents.com/industries/builders-renovation/): rough price ranges from the builder's own rates, photo collection and site visit booking
- [Skip and equipment hire](https://asparagents.com/industries/skip-equipment-hire/): size, availability and full price including permits, booked and paid online
- [Mortgage and insurance brokers](https://asparagents.com/industries/mortgage-insurance-brokers/): guided fact-find, document checklist, uploads from the phone and chasing what is missing
- [Letting agents and property managers](https://asparagents.com/industries/letting-property-management/): tenants report repairs with photos; the tool sorts them by urgency and sends them to the right contractor

## Services

- [All services](https://asparagents.com/services/)
- [White label and outsourcing](https://asparagents.com/white-label/): work for agencies and companies, under their brand if they want
- [Websites and online shops](https://asparagents.com/services/websites/): WordPress websites and WooCommerce shops with SEO foundations
- [SEO](https://asparagents.com/services/seo/): technical and on-page SEO, content and a plain-language monthly report
- [Local SEO](https://asparagents.com/services/local-seo/): Google Business Profile, local pages, business details and reviews
- [GEO and AI visibility](https://asparagents.com/services/geo-ai-visibility/): checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews mention a business, fixes what the checks point to and reports monthly
- [Social media management](https://asparagents.com/services/social-media-management/): content calendar, post designs, captions, scheduling and reporting
- [Accessibility fixes](https://asparagents.com/services/accessibility-fixes/): fixes the issues an accessibility reporting tool lists, on the platform the site already uses
- [One-time WordPress support](https://asparagents.com/services/wordpress-support/): one WordPress issue fixed, paid only when the client is happy with the result
- [Prices](https://asparagents.com/prices/): fixes from $27, websites from $447, shops from $747, SEO and GEO $247 a month, social media $147 a month (US dollars)
